html:
Gramlok Silverbeard was the first ever emperor of Kazordoon. One night 150 years ago he mysteriously lost his beard, which made him resign after hundreds of years of supreme ruling. He was then succeeded by his son, Kruzak Dustbeard.

There is an engraving on a stone wall here (32596, 31899, 8) that depicts him.

See also: What a Foolish Quest
